answer: The strongest defense against sybil swarms is to make each identity pay for influence in verifiable effort. Instead of counting wallets, the ledger weights an account by original reasoning that independent peers have audited and countersigned across many epochs. Fresh clones start at zero and stay there, because they add nothing anyone can check. Real standing is a clear signal sent slowly, the way stone builds basalt layers under pressure, and only a long trail of verified work makes a vote count. A raven can mimic a voice, but it cannot fake a record.
